title: MOXIR v2.11 — the 50 scenes
what: v2.11: 50 scenes (MOXIR 2026-10-17: the 50 scenes (looks + cue list) for project moxir-v2-10 (rig v2.10), in the rig look schema plus `heads` (moving-head motion, lead spec 2026-10-15); v3 re-colour (Palette 3) after the owner's 06:0x 'still too many red')
schema: the beta v0.9 snapshot schema (rigs/moxir-beta-v0.9-lights-2026-10-07.json: fixtures[{id,type,position,p,r,colour,angle_rad}] + solids[{id,name,kind,p,r,s}]), with status/moments/dmx/power_w/circuit per fixture and laser per cube. versions.mjs's rule schema places by mount rules and cannot hold per-unit positions; the build loads this file into a copy of beta as ops. v1.1 adds: stage (the booth move), views (the room buttons), checks_v1_1, crew, entrance, organiser.
frame: hall frame: metres, Y up, +x house right, +z toward the entry; rotations three.js Euler XYZ radians, a spot's unrotated beam points -Y; angle_rad = half the beam angle; box solids base-anchored; truss origin at the section centre, tower at the base plate (src/rigbuild/pieces.js), a tower's s[1] scales the 6 m catalogue tower.

looks.title: The road in
looks.intent: Doors: outside, the road glows toxic green and the entrance dark amber; inside, the plane in low steel blue.
looks.notes: outside = the owner's rule (road toxic green, entrance dark amber, 03:5x), unchanged

looks.title: First light
looks.intent: Blackout and the plane behind the DJ alone in cold white, leaning very slowly.
looks.notes: the owner's 'blackout + one beam': a part is 6 beams, the closest the data can say

looks.title: Slow sweep
looks.intent: The six cold white beams lean toward the floor and back, one slow sweep every 22 s; the DJ back in ice.

looks.title: Steel breath
looks.intent: The DJ plane turns steel blue and breathes; a ripple of lean runs across it; petrol behind the DJ.

looks.title: The DJ alone
looks.intent: Steel blue plane, a warm white (3200 K) kicker on the DJ, a soft pulse on the beams only.
looks.notes: warm white = the tungsten key of the stage (LEE 204 Full CTO), the one warm thing of act 1

looks.title: Ice rays
looks.intent: The four rays behind the DJ rise in ice, a slow wave rolling toward him.

looks.title: The wall wakes
looks.intent: The twelve side beams in petrol; a comet walks down the walls to the DJ.

looks.title: Cold columns
looks.intent: The side beams in cold white, straight columns in the haze, crossing gently.

looks.title: Rust, low
looks.intent: The rays in rose-copper and the cut in warm white, each lamp sparking on its own count: the rust of the hall.
looks.notes: the one warm moment of act 1, now without red: rose-copper (t5 #ad756c hue; rust returns warm light best, measured); sparkle only at 20 bpm

looks.title: First net
looks.intent: The green laser net appears over the floor, breathing, the DJ plane low in poster green.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

looks.notes: the poster's green arrives: lasers diode green, lamps poster green (t1/t2 hue 126 deg)

looks.title: Green chase
looks.intent: The side beams in poster green chase down the walls, a lean ripples along them.

looks.title: Run to the DJ
looks.intent: The poster glow runs down both walls to the DJ on every half beat; the plane glows green.

looks.title: Rays pulse
looks.intent: The rays pulse mint at half time; the plane behind leans in a wave of poster glow.

looks.title: The cut
looks.intent: The truss over the DJ in poster glow, blocks flipping; the walls low and steady in green, mint behind the DJ.

looks.title: Left, right
looks.intent: The two walls answer each other in cold white; the beams trace a mirrored X over a petrol plane.

looks.title: Glow comet
looks.intent: One comet of poster glow runs through the rays out toward the entrance over a mint cut.

looks.title: Scissors
looks.intent: The six beams behind the DJ in poster glow lean against each other like scissors (the teasers' crossing beams).

looks.title: Green comb
looks.intent: The laser comb pulses green at half time over a cold white plane (t5: white beams, green lasers, haze).

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

looks.title: Ping-pong rays
looks.intent: A petrol head bounces across the rays, left to right and back, under a cold white plane.

looks.title: Riser
looks.intent: Before the drop: white walls and plane, mint rays, the cut turns lavender; all pulse on the beat.
looks.notes: lavender enters on the cut: the colour of the peak to come

looks.title: White cathedral
looks.intent: The drop: every beam in cold white over lavender rays; the walls turn a mirrored bow-tie, the rays pump.

looks.title: Strobe hit
looks.intent: The whole hall strobes cold white for 6 s (engine cap: under 3 flashes a second).

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Everything in ember, pumping on the beat; a lean ripples across all beams. The one red scene of the first peak.
looks.notes: the owner's 'red room' (09-28 loop): red as an accent, 20 s; the floor stays rose-copper; pump = 3 flashes/s max (WCAG 2.3.1 red-flash limit met)

looks.title: The storm
looks.intent: Green lasers, cold white walls and cut, petrol rays; the walls flip and trace an X.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

looks.title: The matrix
looks.intent: The laser comb at its cap over rose-copper rays, breathing; the lavender plane ripples.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

looks.title: Pump white
looks.intent: All eighteen beams in cold white hit on the beat and turn mirrored bow-ties.

looks.title: Radar
looks.intent: A lavender radar line sweeps round the rays; the rose-copper plane beams circle in a ripple.

looks.title: Blinders
looks.intent: The cut, the kicker, the key and the rays hit full ash on every beat: the blinder moment.
looks.notes: no blinder fixtures in the kit: the truss washes stand in; ash (the warm white) is closest to a tungsten blinder (taste)

looks.title: Copper scissors
looks.intent: Rose-copper walls and a lavender plane flip on the half beat and cross fast.
looks.notes: v2 id red-scissors: ember walls became rose-copper (the beams show the wheel's Pink)

looks.title: Sparkle peak
looks.intent: Lavender walls and a cold white plane sparkle, each on its own count, over a rose-copper cut.

looks.title: Drop away
looks.intent: Almost dark: the plane in deep sea (the beam wheel's cyan), one slow lean, the floor glowing petrol.

looks.title: One beam back
looks.intent: The plane returns in cold white, low, a lean travels across it; warm white on the DJ.

looks.title: Blue wave
looks.intent: A deep sea wave rolls along the rays and petrol floor strips toward the DJ; the cut holds the floor in lavender.
looks.notes: floor here = cut down at 0.3 (still), the strips join the wave in petrol (not pure blue: the eye cannot focus it on the floor)

looks.title: Ice mist
looks.intent: The walls in low ice and the cut in cold white breathe together; the beams barely cross.

looks.title: Slow eight
looks.intent: Only the plane, in lavender, drawing one slow mirrored X every 29 s.

looks.title: Sea steel
looks.intent: Outside, the road and the entrance spark in their own colours; inside, the rays glow deep sea.
looks.notes: v2 id uv-steel: the UV went with the outside rule; the rays are deep sea now

looks.title: Deep tent
looks.intent: Rays deep sea, the plane petrol, the walls lavender, all swelling slowly, a lean ripples through.

looks.title: Green breath
looks.intent: The laser net alone breathes very slowly in green over the petrol floor.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

looks.title: Cold rise
looks.intent: The build back: a cold white comet climbs the walls toward the entrance over deep sea rays.

looks.title: Riser two
looks.intent: Lavender walls, white plane, rose-copper rays and cut pulse on the beat, the beams lean fast: the second drop is coming.

looks.title: Second drop
looks.intent: White-out: cold white lasers and every beam; the rays pump, the walls turn mirrored bow-ties.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

looks.title: Ice strobe
looks.intent: The whole hall strobes ice for 6 s: the hit of the second peak.
looks.notes: v2 id red-strobe: no strobe in a saturated colour (WCAG 2.2 2.3.1 red flash; Harding et al. 2005), so ice

looks.title: The cathedral turns
looks.intent: All the beams in cold white circle in a ripple, the cut breathes steel blue.

looks.title: Ice and fire
looks.intent: Cold white walls, an ember plane, ice rays; blocks flip, the beams trace an X.
looks.notes: red accent: the ember plane holds (beams are not in the flip), the flipping rays are ice

looks.title: Red fans
looks.intent: Ember lasers (the red fans of teaser t4) over lavender walls flipping, the rose-copper plane crossing.

laser.note: show desk cap measured 2026-10-09 (peak.desk_caps); the 'lasers' look's 1.0 is a PREVIS override only

looks.notes: red accent, lasers only: t4 as measured, red fans with pale violet round them (#9982d4)

looks.title: Last strobe
looks.intent: The final hit: everything strobes for 8 s, cold white beams, warm ash washes.

looks.title: Afterglow
looks.intent: Rose-copper rays and a warm white plane breathe down; a slow ripple of lean.
looks.notes: warmth after the peak without red or amber: rose-copper + 3200 K

looks.title: The last run
looks.intent: Steel blue runs up the walls toward the entrance: the way out.

looks.title: Embers out
looks.intent: Outside, the road and entrance spark again; inside only deep ember rays: the last embers.
looks.notes: red accent: deep ember at 0.4, sparkle 20 bpm (3 flashes/s max), over an ice floor

looks.title: One beam (loop)
looks.intent: Back to the start: the plane alone in low cold white, one slow lean; the loop begins again.
